description_en: Renews one or more subscription dedicated hosts
description_zh: 续费一台或者多台包年包月的专有宿主机
kebab_example: aliyun ecs renew-dedicated-hosts --dedicated-host-ids dh-bp199lyny9b30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 1 --period-unit Month --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewDedicatedHosts

parameters.description_en: The list of dedicated host IDs. You can specify up to 100 subscription dedicated host IDs. Specify multiple dedicated host IDs in a JSON array in the format of `["dh-xxxxxxxxx", "dh-yyyyyyyyy", … "dh-zzzzzzzzz"]`. Separate IDs with commas (,).
parameters.description_zh: 专有宿主机的编号列表。最多可以输入100个预付费专有宿主机ID。多个专有宿主机ID用一个格式类似`["dh-xxxxxxxxx", "dh-yyyyyyyyy", … "dh-zzzzzzzzz"]`的JSON数组表示，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
